prior_importants.description: The new sentence makes it sound as if the conductor reviews every session by pinned commit, and its "so" leaves out the actual reason. Decision 118 and the kickoff only give the conductor a security review of sessions that touch critical areas.

The pup skill is meant for any registered repo, but `/triage`, `/teach` and `/review-session` only exist in pupitre's own `.claude/skills/`. In any other repo the console is pointed at skills that aren't there.

process_issues.description: Re-ask on the already-reviewed head 7b0c67ca (unchanged since record 45149201876). Spawned only docs and conventions: the PR changes prose in two markdown skill files (+6/-1) with no logic, trust boundary, workflow, new construct or spec source, so correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety, maintainability and spec were skipped. Both prior importants remain unresolved because the head has not changed.
The conventions reviewer said it did not read .claude/skills/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md or the body of ADR 0118, so this round does not fully cover writing-for-agents rules for the skill files.
